description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, XMoE and SimSMoE, over a training progression measured in thousands of steps, with the y-axis representing BPC (bits per character) as a measure of performance. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps" and scaled linearly in units of thousands (×10³), ranges from 0 to 50,000 steps, with tick labels at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled "BPC", ranges from 1.25 to 2.00 in linear scale. The plot contains two lines: the "XMoE Validating" line is depicted in yellow with a dash-dot line style and circular markers, while the "SimSMoE Validating" line is shown in magenta with a solid line and star markers. Both lines begin at high BPC values near 2.00 at step 0, then rapidly decrease and converge to a stable range between approximately 1.25 and 1.28 BPC after about 20,000 steps. The magenta line remains consistently below the yellow line throughout the entire training range, with both lines leveling off near the end of the plot.
